title: Leading central Hamiltonian parity of original Step45 post-IBP density reconstruction

sources.model_status: Independently reconstructed symbolic densities Ag,Bg,Af,Bf; not a byte-original reexecution

assumptions: Sg=rLg and Sf=rLf with even analytic Lg,Lf near center
pLg=r²G+O(r⁴), pSg=2rG+O(r³) from regular g momentum/shift stationarity
pLf=r²U+O(r⁴), pSf=2rU+O(r³) from f radial momentum primary Step46
pg,pf=O(r²), dust phase gradients O(r), z=rw with w=1/250
Even lapse multipliers N=N0+N2r²+..., M=M0+M2r²+... with independent N0,N2,M0,M2
a,b,mg,mf nonzero; positivity requires separate Step55 premises

identities.g_metric: lim ΔSg/r = lim ΔLg separately for N and M
identities.f_metric: lim ΔSf/r = lim ΔLf separately for N and M, after f momentum primary V=2U
identities.g_momentum: lim ΔpSg/r = 2 lim ΔpLg/r² separately for N and M
identities.f_momentum: lim ΔpSf/r = 2 lim ΔpLf/r² separately for N and M on V=2U
identities.g_D: lim ΔDg/r=0 separately for N and M, hence ΔDg=O(r³) with smooth odd parity
identities.relative_shift_K: ΔK=O(r²) because K=m²Mg²LgLf(β1Sg²+2β2SgSf+β3Sf²) and all metric variations have regular parities
identities.no_center_lapse_ratio_required: All relations hold for independent N0,N2,M0,M2; not a global rank or lapse fixing statement.

negative_control.off_f_primary_variable: V = lim pSf/r, not yet constrained to 2U
negative_control.f_momentum_defect: lim(ΔpSf/r-2 ΔpLf/r²) = M0 U(2U-V)/(2 b² mf)
negative_control.conclusion: The f radial momentum primary V=2U is indispensable to generic M-lapse center parity. Tests reject dropping it.

next: Coherently import byte-original Step45/55/57/58/59/60 and test complete constraints; compute center O(r³) coefficients of ΔDg and ΔK/r² under the genuine X_H then reduce A_N,B_N,A_M,B_M using full Step55 physical background, keeping Hamiltonian Δz' and boundary terms.
